profile_text.body:
Ericsson is a Stockholm-based public company, trading under the ticker ERIC, that describes itself as powering the networks that connect billions. Per its own site, it works across 5G, AI-driven automation, cloud, and enterprise connectivity, and it presents its CTO's view of networks becoming programmable, autonomous, and AI-native. Its stated focus areas include trusted AI for networks, network slicing and orchestration, Open Radio Access Network transformation, and early work on 6G as an intelligent fabric connecting people and machines.

The site material is largely positioning rather than product detail. It cites AT&T's Open RAN transformation as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network, and frames AI's move into the physical world as making connectivity a strategic advantage for communications service providers. No specific Ericsson products, lawsuits, or MCP servers appear in the records. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000717826 and is listed as a for-profit public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
